methodology.sampleUnit: ns per operation averaged inside one timed batch; not individual call latency
methodology.upperBoundMargin: Hypothetical proportional reduction needed to move existing ratio CI upper bound to 1.05 with unchanged log variance. A planning margin, not an estimated optimization gain or guarantee of future acceptance.
methodology.tails: Top five samples and >5x own pooled median counts are descriptive only; all samples remain in official means/CIs.
methodology.order: The frozen runner alternates framework order by round. Fixed lane sequence, preflight and shared heap confound causal order/GC attribution.
methodology.historical: Different five-launch cohorts and v1/v2 lane matrices; descriptive changes only. No new paired CI between old and current runs.

nitroLaneControls.interpretation: Same Nitro method measured in two sequential lane phases; exploratory phase association, not Rustra guard overhead or a causal order test.
